media.disclosure: AI-generated marketing illustration inspired by the creature system; not gameplay.

professionalNetwork.body:
A new way to share the game

Adults can now download a one-page Mythical Void card, print it or send it, and use its QR code to open the free browser game.

• The QR code goes straight to mythicalvoid.com with no tracking code attached.
• The card includes one real Project Beacon game screen.
• The large creature-universe image is clearly labelled as generated artwork, not gameplay.

See what changed: https://mythicalvoid.com/resources/mythical-void-play-share-card.pdf

The Project Beacon story is live

A new spoiler-light story page now explains the crash of Wanderer-77, first contact, six living realms and the choice waiting at the heart of Project Beacon.

• Six realm images come from the real running game.
• The page explains why the guardians are restored rather than destroyed.
• The ending remains for players to discover themselves.
